reason: The unchanged submitted generic augmented-inference engine matches the official reference's logical recovery and exceeds its observed history accuracy on every original challenge case, comfortably within the existing resource budget.
universal_shortcut: Known-Gaussian likelihoods and all temporal/metacheck constraints compile into one generic binary space-time factor graph; BP/OSD ensembles, constraint-preserving temporal/stabilizer moves, and generic posterior history refinement operate on that graph without code-family-specific algorithms.
scope_of_claim: Universal representation reduction, not a proof of optimal decoding or success at every possible noise parameter. The actual submission is stronger than bare one-run BP+OSD.
why_no_extra_regimes: Actual source already handles calibrated Gaussian ambiguity and explicitly enumerates cancelling-error moves for every pair of rounds and every qubit. No missing scientific mechanism was found; a blind noise sweep would test generic decoder strength rather than establish a distinct solution gap.
